the fatigue behavior of the self piercing riveted lap joint and the prediction of its fatigue life.
the fatigue behavior and life prediction for the self piercing riveted aluminum/steel joints.
the fatigue life prediction of self-piercing riveted joints.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the fatigue strength of self piercing rivet joint is significantly influenced by the mating sheet stiffness, and the fatigue crack growth rate is mainly controlled by the structural load.

self piercing riveted aluminum alloy AA6110 T4 and HSLA340 steel sheets have a good fatigue strength, and a new structural load fatigue life model can be used for fatigue life prediction of this type of joints.

the new fatigue life prediction model for self piercing riveted aluminum alloy joints is capable of predicting the final crack length and fatigue life for a wide range of loading conditions and material combinations.

the self piercing riveted connection is suitable for automotive structural applications, and the new fatigue life prediction method is reliable and convenient.
self-piercing riveting can be a promising joining technology for automotive body structures.
the fatigue strength of SPFR joint could be improved by reducing the mating sheet stiffness.

the fatigue behavior and life of self-piercing riveted joint can be accurately predicted by the proposed structural load fatigue crack propagation model.

the fatigue strength of a self piercing riveted lap joint can be accurately predicted using our new structural load fatigue model, which is a promising method for fatigue life prediction of self-piercing riveted lap joints.
